# Access Checklist

Collect access **once**. Never send "did you get a chance to share…?" five times. Ask for proper permissions (user
invites / roles), never passwords over WhatsApp or email. Edit the list sent to clients in `onboarding.access_items`.

| Area | Item | How to grant |
|---|---|---|
| **Marketing** | Meta Ads / Business Manager | Business settings → People → add as Partner/Employee |
| | Google Ads | Admin → Access and security → invite with Standard access |
| | LinkedIn Page | Page admin tools → Manage admins |
| | Instagram | via Meta Business Suite |
| | Google Business Profile | Settings → Managers → add as Manager |
| **Analytics** | Google Analytics | Admin → Property access management → Editor |
| | Search Console | Settings → Users and permissions → Full |
| | CRM / dashboards | user invite |
| **Operations** | Google Drive / Notion / Slack / PM tool | share folder / workspace invite |
| | Domain registrar / hosting | delegate access or user account (not the owner's password) |
| **Brand** | Logo files, brand guidelines, creative assets, past campaigns | shared folder |

When everything is in, tick **All access received** in the dashboard.
